title: ToolRequest
description: Canonical local tool API request. All surfaces (MCP, CLI, TUI, dashboard) map actions into this shape before daemon validation and policy evaluation. See ADR-0002 and issue #103.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier for idempotency and audit correlation.

issued_at.description: Timestamp at which the surface created this request.

actor_id.description: Who is issuing this request (user id, agent id, or daemon-authenticated equivalent).

session_id.description: Session or workspace context for scoping policy evaluation.

workspace.description: Workspace root (repo path or equivalent) for policy scope resolution.

policy_scope.description: Policy scope tags for governance rule selection.

audit_metadata.description: Free-form key-value pairs for audit trail (e.g. surface=mcp).

name.description: The command name from the local command registry.

params.description: Command-specific parameters. Shape depends on the command name.
